summary: Contestants demonstrate their knowledge and skills in medical coding by answering theory and application questions using ICD-10-CM and CPT code sets. The event is open to any secondary or postsecondary division contestant. Participants must assign codes accurately and follow official guidelines and audit standards.
time_limits: No more than ten (10) minutes orientation
No more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
No more than ten (10) minutes wrap-up
what_to_bring: Published and/or unpublished non-electronic written reference materials
(Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
Suggested resource: Manual ICD-10-CM (2025) and CPT (2025), only physical copies allowed, no electronic references
competencies: Define current coding terminology, symbols, and abbreviations
Apply proper sequencing principles using medical coding guidelines
Demonstrate medical coding knowledge and skills using ICD-10-CM and CPT in diverse scenarios, assigning codes accurately to ensure compliance with official guidelines and audit standards
Identify and interpret coding systems based on structure, format, and context, distinguishing both diagnostic and procedural code sets
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
No equipment, supplies, or materials other than those specified for an event will be allowed in the testing area
No previous Business Professionals of America tests (handwritten, photocopied, or keyed) may be taken into the testing area. Violation of this rule will result in disqualification.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this application event.
